title: Design System: LingQ Sentence Playback Companion

footer-label.purpose: Replay and Playback Mode labels, matching LingQ's footer buttons.

caption.purpose: Menu heading, option descriptions, shortcuts, and status.

motion.name: menu-reveal
motion.purpose: Open the Playback Mode menu without delaying operation.

components.name: Footer Item
components.description: A LingQ-style footer action: a line icon over a label, no box.
components.css: .ds-footer-item { display: inline-grid; grid-template-rows: 1fr 1fr; place-items: center; min-width: 64px; min-height: 44px; padding: 6px 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: inherit; font: inherit; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 21px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-footer-item:hover { background: rgb(127 127 127 / 10%); } .ds-footer-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid Highlight; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Playback Mode Menu
components.description: An elevated menu of Pause, Continue, and Repeat with a check on the current Playback Mode.
components.css: .ds-menu { width: 20rem; padding: 6px; border-radius: 12px; background: Canvas; color: CanvasText; box-shadow: 0 8px 28px rgb(9 26 47 / 18%), 0 0 0 1px rgb(127 127 127 / 18%); } .ds-menu [aria-checked="true"] { background: color-mix(in srgb, #5c5ce0 12%, transparent); }

narrative.overview: A restrained and precise control layer that supports LingQ's live lesson without competing with it.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Playback Violet marks the selected Playback Mode in the menu only.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: In-flow controls stay flat. Only a temporary overlapping surface, the Playback Mode menu, is elevated.

dos: Inherit LingQ typography, text color, and theme behavior.
donts: Do not restyle or obscure LingQ-owned UI.
Do not add decorative shadows, gradients, fonts, or accents.
